narrative.overview: A compact personal note on warm paper, with a small sans-serif name, direct links and short factual sections. An original pixel penguin beside the name adds a small, optional interaction while the text remains the main experience.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and quiet green links
dos: Do keep the name, introduction and project descriptions concise.
Do preserve visible focus, the skip link and reduced-motion support.
Do keep companion movement bounded and available from the keyboard.
donts: Don't invent project claims, skills or repository destinations.
Don't make the companion a prerequisite for reading or navigation.
